label: D2 after a rare a1->S2 transition (stronger after an unrewarded previous trial, early in episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and landed in S2 (rare transition). (phase==D2)&(action==1)&(state==2) covers 99.9% of activations and mass, but precision is only 0.25 because the reset gate goes above threshold on only part of those steps. Two observed modulators raise it above threshold: an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward==0 holds 78% of mass, and the top-quartile activations are 94% covered) and episode time (rate drops steadily from about 2.5% in trials 0-9 to zero after trial 70, so it looks like slow drift in the hidden state). The recorded predicate (all terms observed at D2) gets dev F1 0.70. Variants: (prev_reward==0 | ep_trial<30) gives the same F1 with mass recall 0.97. It never fires at D1 or GO, on a2 choices, on S1 arrivals, or on common transitions. Prior-trial outcome and episode position only modulate how strongly it fires.
